title: Nullity of the disagreement boundary
statement: Let $-1\leq\rho\leq1$, and let $(X,Y)$ have the probability distribution obtained from independent standard Gaussian variables $U,V$ by setting $X=U$ and $Y=\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,V$. The boundary of the region $\{(x,y):xy<0\}$ has probability zero under this distribution.
